candidates.title: [Bug]: MoRIIO WRITE producer: preempted request's deferred write submits reallocated blocks
candidates.snippet: ## Summary  - With `MoRIIOConnector` in WRITE mode (the documented default) on a prefill producer, a request preempted after its final chunk retains deferred per-layer `WriteTask`s that name the freed blocks. On resume, `schedule_write` drops the new tasks (same `transfer_id` and layer). When the consumer's allocation arrives, the old tasks submit offsets for blocks already reallocated to another live request. - The run uses `num_kv_blocks=5`, `max_num_seqs=16`, `max_tokens=1` and assumes a TP=1

candidates.snippet: ### Problem  With the default `--hybrid-cache-checkpoints-level 2`, the second turn of a conversation gets `#cached-token: 0` and prefills the whole prompt again. candidates.title: [Feature] HiCache: make L3 an overflow (victim) tier of L2 instead of a mirror
candidates.snippet: ## Checklist - [x] This is a feature request, not a general question. - [x] English.  ## Motivation  With `--hicache-storage-backend`, the stock path writes a page to storage (L3) when it lands in the host pool (L2). L3 therefore holds a copy of the newest part of L2: a page still in L2 is served from L2, and a page evicted from L2 is in L3 only if its admission-time write happened to finish.
